figures.name: Enkai Narok

ability.name: Rain Blessing
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to all allies; cattle and nature allies gain +3 to all stats.

figures.description: The benevolent black aspect of Enkai who brings rain, grass and good fortune to the Maasai.

figures.name: Enkai Nanyokie

ability.name: Red Drought
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to all enemies; remove all regeneration and healing effects for 2 turns.

figures.description: The wrathful red aspect of Enkai who withholds rain, sends lightning and punishes transgressors.

figures.name: Ol Doinyo Lengai

ability.name: Mountain of God
ability.description: Deal 6 fire damage to all enemies; grant earth allies immunity to fire for 2 turns.

figures.description: The sacred volcano of the Maasai — 'Mountain of God' — whose eruptions signal Enkai's direct intervention.

figures.name: Laibon

ability.name: Laibon's Sight
ability.description: Look at all enemy cards; predict and nullify the most dangerous enemy ability for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Maasai spiritual leader and diviner who reads signs, prepares protective medicine and guides the community.

figures.name: Dorobo Hunter

ability.name: First Fire
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 power; enemies cannot extinguish fire or warmth effects this turn.

figures.description: The first man of Maasai legend who kept the fire of the world and from whom all humanity descended.

figures.name: Ilchamus Warrior

ability.name: Lion Mane
ability.description: This card cannot be charmed, frightened or controlled for the battle.

figures.description: The archetypal young Maasai warrior (morani) who proves his courage through lion hunting and battle.

figures.name: Lightning Bird (Maasai)

ability.name: Enkai's Arrow
ability.description: Deal 5 lightning damage; enemy struck cannot use sky or storm abilities next turn.

figures.description: The bird through which Enkai sends lightning to strike down wrongdoers and announce divine displeasure.

figures.name: Cattle Spirit

ability.name: Cattle Gift
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; all ally stats increase by 1 from divine cattle wealth.

figures.description: The sacred spirit of cattle — Enkai's first gift to the Maasai and their greatest spiritual and material wealth.

figures.name: Enkiama

ability.name: Household Shield
ability.description: Prevent one dark ability from affecting any ally this turn.

figures.description: The household protective spirit who guards the enkiama (home) and blesses all who dwell within.

figures.name: Osotua

ability.name: Sacred Bond
ability.description: When this card helps an ally, grant that ally +2 to all stats from the sacred bond.

figures.description: The spirit of osotua — the sacred unbounded obligation between people that cannot be refused or forgotten.

figures.name: Ilkiama Forest Spirit

ability.name: Forest Edge
ability.description: Prevent enemies from approaching past the forest boundary for 1 turn.

figures.description: The protective spirits of the forest edge who mark the boundary between Maasai grazing land and wilderness.

figures.name: Embe Eagle

ability.name: Sky Scout
ability.description: Look at the enemy's next 2 plays before they reveal them.

figures.description: The great eagle whose flight patterns the Laibon reads as messages from Enkai about coming events.

figures.name: Eunoto Elder

ability.name: Rite of Passage
ability.description: One ally gains +3 to all stats from completing a sacred transition.

figures.description: The elder who performs the Eunoto ceremony, shaving the warrior's hair to mark his transition to adulthood.

figures.name: Inkidongi Laibon

ability.name: Supreme Vision
ability.description: Automatically negate the first enemy ability each turn.

figures.description: The Inkidongi clan Laibon whose prophetic and spiritual authority is recognized across all Maasai sections.

figures.name: Ilkiponi Serpent

ability.name: Evil Omen
ability.description: When played, reduce all enemy stats by 1 from dread.

figures.description: The serpent whose appearance is considered a dire omen in Maasai tradition, signaling misfortune.

figures.name: Rain Maker

ability.name: Rain Song
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; restore all nature and earth effects that were removed.

figures.description: The ritual specialist who performs the sacred ceremonies to break drought and bring Enkai's rain.

figures.name: Red Ochre Spirit

ability.name: Ochre Shield
ability.description: Reduce damage taken by warrior allies by 2 for 1 turn.

figures.description: The spirit of the red ochre (engila) that warriors apply to their bodies for protection and power.

figures.name: Moran Youth

ability.name: Age-Set Bond
ability.description: All warrior allies gain +2 speed and +1 power from age-set solidarity.

figures.description: The young Maasai warrior in his moran age-set who protects his community through courage and discipline.

figures.name: Sacred Spear

ability.name: Spear Blessing
ability.description: Prevent one attack from being blocked by an enemy shield or dodge ability.

figures.description: The spirit of the Maasai spear that is never put down and represents the warrior's sacred duty.

figures.name: Enkang Fire

ability.name: Eternal Hearth
ability.description: At the start of each turn, restore 1 HP to all allies for 3 turns.

figures.description: The sacred fire at the center of the Maasai enkang whose flame represents family continuity.
